mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 1.5% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened discount rates affecting future equity pricing.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-tightening 20-day average (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 10,000 jobs from the prior month, it indicates strengthening labor market demand and is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, cumulative 60-day returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day average during non-expansionary periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) of at least 2% predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals weakening aggregate demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during the triggered period.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 105 for two consecutive months, indicating softening supply-side conditions, the S&P 500 5-day forward return is expected to be negative.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive and repeat over 10 non-overlapping windows (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4% for three months suggests labor market slack and is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in 80% of similar slack periods (cumulative p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand spending) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their prior month's levels each contribute additively to a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: The interaction effect rank correlation is below 0.3 over 10 similar expansion regimes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 and UNRATE is below 3.5%, it indicates a strong labor market coupled with easing inflation, predicting a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in 70% of similar dual-condition regimes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in CPIAUCSL (inflation index) by more than 2% in a month followed by a 20-day S&P 500 forward return below the 5% annualized risk-free rate suggests deflationary pressure and reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns exceed the risk-free rate by at least 1% in 80% of similar deflation regimes (p < 0.05).
